name: list_promote_aliases
description:
Get a list of aliases related to the last promote request with their mapping status

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{projectId}/promote/aliases --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

failedOnly.description: Filter results down to aliases that failed to map to the requested deployment

limit.description: Maximum number of aliases to list from a request (max 100).

since.description: Get aliases created after this epoch timestamp.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

until.description: Get aliases created before this epoch timestamp.
